name: Sinclair ZX Spectrum (16K/48K, 128K)

variants.name: ZX Spectrum 128K (and +2)
variants.notes: 8 RAM banks of 16 KB and two 16 KB ROMs, paged through port 0x7FFD; AY-3-8912 sound

cpu.notes: the ULA delays CPU access to 4000-7FFF while it reads the screen (contention); a cycle-exact core must model that

regions.name: ROM
regions.notes: 16 KB BASIC ROM (48K); the 128K has two ROMs paged into this window

regions.name: Screen attributes
regions.notes: 5800-5AFF, 768 bytes: flash, bright, paper, ink for each 8x8 cell

regions.name: RAM
regions.notes: 5B00-FFFF (system variables start at 5C00); 8000-FFFF is the part the 16K model lacks

native.note: plus a border; colour is per 8x8 attribute cell

modes.name: Standard screen (bitmap + attributes)
modes.notes: 8 colours, each normal or bright (black is the same), 2 colours per 8x8 cell; 128K adds a second screen bank

rom.note: 3D00-3FFF, codes 32-127; 0x60 is the pound sign and 0x7F the copyright sign; codes 144-164 are user graphics A-U; 165-255 are BASIC tokens

keyboard.notes: 8 half-rows of 5 keys read through port 0xFE (the high address byte selects rows); CAPS SHIFT and SYMBOL SHIFT

controllers.notes: no standard port; Kempston, Sinclair 1/2 and Cursor interfaces

testMaterial: Homebrew and public-domain tapes only; licences to be checked per item before they are added to the repository
sources: Sinclair ZX Spectrum technical documentation (public reference works, e.g. World of Spectrum / the Spectrum ROM disassembly)
